statusMeaning: design-pattern means guidance only; not an implemented adapter or guarantee.

patterns.name: MCP Wrapper Pattern
patterns.description: Expose a narrow, typed MCP facade over approved REST or SOAP operations. Start read-only and validate every argument.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Reverse Proxy Intent Interceptor
patterns.description: Put a typed, allowlisted API facade in front of legacy services. Do not translate arbitrary natural-language text directly into requests that mutate state.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Database Change Data Capture (CDC) Bridge
patterns.description: Use CDC with schema validation, data minimization, source permission checks, retention, and deletion propagation before forwarding events into a memory service.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Agent Card Metadata Injection
patterns.description: Publish an accurate static capability manifest at /.well-known/agent.json. Treat discovery metadata as untrusted input, not as authorization.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Async Event Bus Adapter
patterns.description: Bridge legacy message queues (RabbitMQ, Kafka, ActiveMQ) into the `hello.mesh` A2A protocol using event schema adapters.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: OAuth-to-DID Token Exchanger
patterns.description: Use a token-exchange gateway to issue a short-lived, scoped credential after validating the OAuth session. A DID is a separate identifier and does not inherit proof of identity automatically.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: GraphQL Federation Layer
patterns.description: Federate only the fields and operations each caller is allowed to access; query batching and round-trip counts depend on the schema and implementation.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: JSON-RPC Schema Reflector
patterns.description: Generate candidate tool schemas from reviewed OpenAPI documents; manually review authorization, side effects, and input constraints before exposing them.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Webhook-to-Intent Transpiler
patterns.description: Parse signed or authenticated webhooks into typed event records. Validate source, timestamp, replay protection, and payload schema before any downstream action.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Headless Browser DOM Wrapper
patterns.description: Use browser automation only against explicitly allowlisted pages and accounts, with scoped sessions and human approval for state-changing actions.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Vector Embedding Backfill
patterns.description: Backfill embeddings only for data with an approved purpose and retention policy; preserve source permissions and deletion requests.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Causal Dead-End Log Extractor
patterns.description: Seed a failure registry only from authorized, redacted incident history, with provenance, retention, and correction/deletion handling.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Shadow Database Cloning
patterns.description: Use database-native snapshots or isolated replicas when supported. Copy-on-write behavior and creation time depend on the provider and workload; no fixed latency is promised.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Document Chunking & Semantic Indexing
patterns.description: Chunk authorized documents while preserving source access controls and citations. Do not treat model confidence scores as verified facts.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Incremental Cache Invalidation
patterns.description: Map cache keys from legacy Redis clusters to agent memory pointers to prevent stale context retrieval.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Log-to-Episodic Memory Parser
patterns.description: Ingest unstructured log files (JSON/Syslog) and parse them into structured episodic memory records.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Schema Version Fingerprinting
patterns.description: Compute SHA-256 hashes of database schemas to detect silent breaking changes before agents run queries.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) Introspection
patterns.description: Expose dead-letter messages read-only first. Retrying or replaying a message requires idempotency checks and explicit approval.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Audit Trail Normalizer
patterns.description: Normalize audit events into a documented receipt format. A hash alone is not a digital signature or proof of execution.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: State snapshot serialization
patterns.description: Serialize only approved, minimized state with schema versions, retention rules, and encryption; do not copy session secrets into memory blobs.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: API Key Vault Mapping
patterns.description: Keep API keys in a secret manager and expose narrow operations through a server-side capability proxy. Never return raw keys to prompts or model output.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: RBAC-to-Guardian Tier Mapper
patterns.description: Map roles conservatively to a documented permission matrix with explicit deny rules and owner review; Guardian tiers are not automatically equivalent to an external RBAC system.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Circuit Breaker Cost Governor
patterns.description: Set hard request, rate, and spend limits, then stop calls on policy thresholds. P99 monitoring is a signal, not a spending-control substitute.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Untrusted Content Isolation and Policy Checks
patterns.description: Keep external content explicitly marked as untrusted and apply context-specific validation. No sanitizer can reliably remove prompt injection from arbitrary text.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Cryptographic Receipt Stamping
patterns.description: Use a digital signature over a canonical receipt with a protected signing key. A SHA-256 digest is an identifier, not a signature.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Automated Least-Privilege Scoping
patterns.description: Use observed usage to recommend permission reductions; require an owner to review before changing grants because rare capabilities may still be necessary.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Human-in-the-Loop Webhook Gate
patterns.description: Require explicit human authorization for high-impact changes, bound to the exact action, target, amount, and expiry. A chat notification alone is not an approval.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Session Continuity Tokenizer
patterns.description: Store session continuity only in a dedicated encrypted secret store, with short expiry and explicit account scope. Prefer server-issued OAuth over browser-cookie portability.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Ephemeral Sandbox Isolation
patterns.description: Run untrusted code in a properly configured isolation boundary with resource limits and deny-by-default network egress. Containers alone are not a security boundary equivalent to a VM.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Deterministic Replay Recording
patterns.description: Record deterministic inputs and stubbed external responses for repeatable tests. Replay must not repeat real-world side effects.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Multi-Model Consensus Firewall
patterns.description: Use independent policy checks and human approval for high-impact actions. Multiple model outputs are not a security boundary or authorization mechanism.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Compliance Guardrail Injector
patterns.description: Apply compliance controls in data access, retention, and audit systems. Adding policy text to a prompt does not establish regulatory compliance.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Self-Revoking Capability Passports
patterns.description: Use signed, scoped, expiring capabilities with revocation. Do not base authorization on a model confidence score.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Audit Log Merkle Tree Anchoring
patterns.description: Merkle-root anchoring can make later tampering detectable only when roots are published to a trusted independent system and verification is retained.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Zero-Trust Egress Filtering
patterns.description: Apply deny-by-default egress at the network boundary, with DNS/IP controls, logging, and a reviewed allowlist.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: AST Symbol Reflector
patterns.description: Parse source files into AST symbol nodes using a project-specific parser and validated repository scope; `src/engine/ast.ts` is an example location, not a shipped path.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Pre-Commit TypeScript Compiler Gate
patterns.description: Run the project’s configured TypeScript compiler as a pre-commit or CI gate. A pre-commit hook is optional and can be bypassed; CI remains authoritative.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Automated Test Runner Wrapper
patterns.description: Wrap legacy test suites (Jest, PyTest, JUnit) in MCP tools so agents receive clean JSON test receipts.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Dependency Graph Visualizer
patterns.description: Map imports and exports across legacy codebases to guide multi-agent refactoring tasks.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: AML Transpilation Pipeline
patterns.description: Use a model or parser to draft AML from a specification, then validate and review it. AML v1 is static and this pipeline must never execute generated source.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: N+1 Query Detector
patterns.description: Detect likely N+1 query patterns and propose measured alternatives; do not automatically rewrite locking or transaction semantics.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Dead Code Pruner
patterns.description: Identify likely unreferenced code and submit a reviewed patch with build and test evidence. Never delete code automatically based only on static heuristics.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Automated Patch Reverter
patterns.description: Automate rollback only when side effects are known to be reversible and reconciliation is tested; database backups and external actions need separate recovery plans.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Cross-Language Fuzzing Bridge
patterns.description: Fuzz documented API boundaries with bounded, isolated test inputs and explicit authorization. Keep fuzz traffic out of production unless approved.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Model Arbitrage Optimizer
patterns.description: Route work using measured task quality, latency, privacy, and cost. Cheap/local models still require validation and policy controls.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Token-Budgeted Context Packer
patterns.description: Pack context to a measured model/tokenizer budget and preserve source references; approximate counts can differ from the provider tokenizer.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Sleep-Cycle Code Refinement
patterns.description: Schedule maintenance only with a bounded change scope, tests, review, and rollback path; background agents must not silently rewrite production code.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Multi-Agent Git Merge Arbiter
patterns.description: Use tools to propose conflict resolutions, then require normal tests and human review before merging. Model votes do not prove a merge is correct.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Documentation-to-Spec Generator
patterns.description: Parse markdown READMEs and API docs into structured JSON contract schemas.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.

patterns.name: Zero-Downtime Blue/Green DNS Swap
patterns.description: Use staged, health-checked traffic switching with explicit rollback. A DNS update is not inherently atomic and DNS caches may delay propagation.
patterns.implementation_note: Concept only; not implemented by this catalog. Requires a concrete integration, authorization policy, operational owner, and tests before use.
